AI & Agents

AI & Agents apps for Omarchy

14 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-20 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 14 ai & agents packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-20.

Every ai & agents package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • claude-code omarchy pkg add claude-code
    An AI coding agent that works directly in your terminal, understands your whole codebase, and ships changes for you.
  • crush-bin omarchy pkg add crush-bin
    Your coding bestie, now living in your favorite terminal.
  • cursor-cli omarchy pkg add cursor-cli
    Cursor's AI agents, running straight from your shell.
  • github-copilot-cli omarchy pkg add github-copilot-cli
    GitHub Copilot's coding agent, right in your terminal.
  • grok-bot omarchy pkg add grok-bot
    An always-on AI teammate with its own persistent cloud computer.
  • herdr omarchy pkg add herdr
    One terminal that keeps every AI coding agent running and visible.
  • hermes-desktop omarchy pkg add hermes-desktop
    A native desktop shell for Nous Research's self-improving Hermes agent.
  • lmstudio omarchy pkg add lmstudio
    Discover, download, and chat with open-source AI models entirely on your own machine.
  • lmstudio-bin omarchy pkg add lmstudio-bin
    The prebuilt-binary package of LM Studio, for running local AI models without waiting on a build.
  • omarchy-herdr omarchy pkg add omarchy-herdr
    A persistent terminal runtime for keeping AI coding agents alive and organized in the background.
  • openai-codex-bin omarchy pkg add openai-codex-bin
    OpenAI's coding agent, living in your terminal and wired into your ChatGPT or API account.
  • openai-codex-desktop omarchy pkg add openai-codex-desktop
    ChatGPT's desktop home for OpenAI's autonomous coding agent.
  • perplexity omarchy pkg add perplexity
    Perplexity's official desktop app for cited, AI-powered answers instead of a list of links.
  • t3code-bin omarchy pkg add t3code-bin
    One control surface to drive Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents from your desktop or phone.
